caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a slightly overhanging lid, primarily painted in a muted greenish-blue color. The front panel of the chest features two large, symmetrical, arched decorative sections, each bordered in a reddish color and filled with intricate floral and foliate patterns in earthy tones including cream, red, green, blue, and yellow. Within each decorative panel, there are several stylized birds perched amidst the flowering branches, with distinct colors on their wings and bodies. The space between the two arched panels includes a section with faintly inscribed text that reads "JACOB RICKERT ANNO 1782." A metal keyhole and escutcheon are centered above the text. The chest has a wooden base and top edge in a natural brown wood color that contrasts with the painted body, and the perspective shows the right side of the chest receding into the background, revealing its depth. The artist's signature “FRANCES LICHTEN” appears in the lower right corner of the chest.
title: Pa. German Chest
